cohort: 228 infants born at ≤30 weeks of gestation, including 65 SGA infants and 163 appropriate for gestational age (AGA) infants.
finding: Being SGA is a risk factor for neurodevelopmental impairment in preterm infants born at ≤30 weeks of gestation.
birth_weight: SGA group: 810 ± 135 g, AGA group: 1175 ± 183 g
